channel.title: Federal Reserve Board - Press Releases
channel.description: Press releases issued by the Federal Reserve Board

item.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement on monetary policy decisions
item.description: The Federal Open Market Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4.75 to 5.0 percent. Indicators suggest that economic activity has continued to expand at a solid pace, with inflation remaining somewhat elevated above target.

item.title: Federal Reserve Board announces enforcement action against regional bank holding company
item.description: The Federal Reserve Board announced a consent cease and desist order against Metro Financial Corp for deficiencies in risk management and compliance with capital adequacy requirements.
